title: Welcome
description: Start here: what the demo shows and what to try.

content: This demo shows a Hune server that reads a local ClickHouse database with synthetic data.
Hune stores each dashboard as one JSON file. The data are five services on six hosts, for the last 24 hours.
- [Service overview](/d/service-overview): stat panels, a table, a bar chart and annotations.
- [Traffic](/d/traffic): time series with thresholds, bars, a pie chart and a histogram.
- [Latency](/d/latency): gauges, a heatmap, a state timeline and logs.
- [Server inventory](/d/servers): a table with coloured cells, links and a footer.
1. Change the time range in the top right corner.
2. Select a host or a region in the variables.
3. Open the menu of a panel, then choose Edit or Inspect.
4. Open the menu of the dashboard to see the history of versions.
All values in this demo are synthetic.
